title: bug: NO_TEAM_MEMBERSHIP tells agent seats to call moe.join_team, which their tools/list hides
description:
Observed 2026-10-30 in an interactive architect session (architect-32ff5555):
- The seat had teamId null, while every other architect, QA and most workers were on team-a94dc136bb2b49c2aa8df6977c354696.
- In-session moe.claim_next_task {statuses:['PLANNING']} returned hasNext:false, code NO_TEAM_MEMBERSHIP, with nextAction moe.join_team. Six unassigned PLANNING tasks sat in epic-be924fb8, and architect-4ae016fb held that epic's PLANNING column.
- The agent could not follow the nextAction. TOOL_AUDIENCE in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/index.ts maps 'moe.join_team' and 'moe.list_teams' to [], so toolsForRole hides them from the architect, worker and QA tools/list.
- The wrapper's pre-claim join retry (scripts/moe-agent.sh, around line 2082) only runs between CLI sessions, never for claims made inside an interactive session.
- util/teamMembershipHeal.ts only heals tombstoned former members.
Net effect: the session's only recourse is to end early.

Deliverable: an agent seat refused for missing team membership gets a remedy it can actually execute. Two options:
- name a role-visible action, e.g. 'end the session; the wrapper retries moe.join_team before its next claim';
- or have the claim path heal a teamless seat into its role team, as the wrapper would.
The planner picks one.

NOT in scope: changing the solo epic+status rule or the TOOL_AUDIENCE policy for other tools.

Verification: cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test
definitionOfDone: A NO_TEAM_MEMBERSHIP refusal served to an architect, worker or qa caller names only actions that caller can take: no tool missing from toolsForRole(role). New vitest cases assert this for each of the three roles.
Existing teamMembershipHeal and solo epic+status rule tests pass unchanged.
